description: Offering registry for the Callora API marketplace. Publishes metadata through a catalog contract and tracks registered offerings.

cross_contract.catalog: OfferingCatalog::put_offering — invoked before persisting registry state

get_offerings_by_developer.description: Paginated, registration-ordered list of offerings for a developer. limit is clamped to 50; limit 0 or start past the end returns an empty page. Index and records have their TTL extended on read.

testing.xcontract: contracts/registry/tests/xcontract.rs covers catalog and token callee panic/revert safety
testing.developer_index: contracts/registry/tests/developer_index.rs covers the per-developer index and pagination
